speaker: Daniel
text: After the war, Audrey and her mother left the Netherlands and arrived in the U.K. Her dream of becoming a prime dancer drove her into a rigorous schedule at a famous ballet school. Later, she was spotted by a producer and eventually landed a role in the film Roman Holiday starring Gregory Peck, one of Hollywood's top leading men.
